in_sanskrit.name: Viresh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Poison
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Viresh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Viresh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vish', which means 'poison'. This name is given to a boy born on a day when the planets are in such alignment that the child is believed to have the power to control poison. This name signifies strength, courage, and the ability to protect oneself and others from harm.
